probes.name: between-reversed
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim f As Object,g As Object
Range("A1").Value=5
Set f=Range("A1").FormatConditions.Add(xlCellValue,xlBetween,10,1)
f.Font.Bold=True
Probe="base=" & CStr(Range("A1").Font.Bold) & ";display=" & CStr(Range("A1").DisplayFormat.Font.Bold) & ";italic=" & CStr(Range("A1").DisplayFormat.Font.Italic) & ";line=" & CStr(Range("A1").DisplayFormat.Borders(xlEdgeBottom).LineStyle) & ";color=" & CStr(Range("A1").DisplayFormat.Borders(xlEdgeBottom).Color)
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe="ERR:" & Err.Number
End Function

probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Dim f As Object,g As Object
Set f=Range("A1").FormatConditions.Add(Type:=xlExpression,Formula1:="=TRUE")
f.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbRed
f.StopIfTrue=False
Set g=Range("A1").FormatConditions.Add(Type:=xlExpression,Formula1:="=TRUE")
